result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. result.summary: The image depicts an urban street with multiple travel lanes and embedded trolley tracks. While wide sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the pedestrian crossing lacks high-visibility markings and features like curb extensions to reduce exposure distance.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and create a trip hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending from the foreground into the distance.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The distance across the street is significant without a refuge island, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers and clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross, helping pedestrians make informed decisions about when to enter the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane one-way urban arterial with a marked zebra crosswalk. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals create a high-exposure environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Multi-lane One-way Traffic
hazards.description: The wide, one-way configuration often encourages higher vehicle speeds and can lead to multiple-threat crash scenarios.
